name: Chicken Stew (Cacciatore) with Pepper, Zucchini & Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice onions; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add both to the bowl with the onion and garlic; set aside.

Cut each cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower; place in a large bowl and set aside.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces; sprinkle with cornstarch and season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
3 tbsp cornstarch
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 4-5 minutes. (The chicken will not be cooked all the way through.)
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add onion, garlic, bell pepper, zucchini, and spices to the pot with the chicken; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp rosemary, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, roughly chop olives.

When the veggies are done, add olives, tomatoes, and broth to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until stew has thickened and chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: While the stew is simmering, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower and salt; cook, stirring often, until cauliflower is lightly golden and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the stew is done, add half of the basil to the pot; stir to combine and remove from heat. (Reserve remaining basil for garnish.)
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and chicken stew between bowls; top with reserved basil and enjoy!
